confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Metro Manila price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked at roughly three times the beer anchor. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview at 4.00 pm on 15 October 2026; the page itself was not opened directly. Search output also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown source links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Anchors follow Metro Manila price tiers (Makati and BGC for mid-range and 3-star, Malate and Ermita for budget hostels and hotels), with typical Southeast Asian capital price levels used as a rough cross-check.
